# Skill Cards

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill-cards.mjs — do not hand-edit. -->
<!-- Regenerate with: npm run build:cards -->

One release record per skill, following the NVIDIA skill-card template (<https://docs.nvidia.com/skills/skill-cards>): description, owner, license, use case, deployment geography, requirements, known risks and mitigations, references, output, version, and ethical considerations. 72 skills, 72 cards, all stamped for release 0.16.0. Each card derives from its skill's own SKILL.md plus pack-wide release facts, and `npm run build:cards` regenerates the set; `npm test` fails when any card is stale.
